lessons.trigger_condition: V387 can gate uncertainty and operational regime transitions, but it still evaluates each cycle primarily from the current candidate set. It does not maintain a long-horizon per-regime champion/challenger portfolio, conservative verified reward lower bounds, bounded policy quarantine/retirement, or explicit resource budgets for exploration, learning and revalidation.
lessons.prevention_rule: V388 must preserve V387 as the upstream hard gate, learn portfolio memory only from verified V385 outcome rewards, track short and long reward EWMA plus conservative lower-confidence bounds per operational regime, quarantine or retire repeatedly regressing non-recovery policies, keep recovery actions available, use resource headroom/drift/uncertainty to bound optional learning and exploration, and prioritize source-level feature proposals without executing or generating source code.
validation_required: watched paths are main, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v388.py and tablet_runtime_manifest.py
main evolve route uses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v388.py with tablet_gpt domain
tablet runtime manifest includes v388 while preserving v387 and prior controllers
portfolio memory uses only verified V385 reward rows meeting the minimum verified-sample gate
policy memory is partitioned by operational regime and never predicts market direction
short and long reward EWMA plus conservative reward lower-confidence bound are retained
repeated verified regression quarantines and eventually retires non-recovery policies
recovery-class actions are never quarantined solely by portfolio regression
resource critical or high-drift states reduce optional exploration and learning and increase revalidation
exploration budget is advisory only and can never force execution
V387 and all earlier hard gates cannot be bypassed
source-level feature backlog remains non-executable and requires protected PR/CI, regression, integrity, alignment and actual-output validation
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V388 adds verified long-horizon policy portfolio memory, resource budgeting and prioritized feature backlog only; it never imports peer model weights/raw state/grading calibration, generates or rewrites source code, executes arbitrary commands, writes Git/main, weakens verification, auto-promotes facts/prices/grades, predicts market direction, or claims physical-device success without evidence.
